item.title: Molly Young and the Fight for Answers About Her Death
item.description: Molly Young was found dead in her former boyfriend’s Carbondale apartment in March 2012. A coroner’s jury ruled the manner of death undetermined, and prosecutors found insufficient evidence to bring charges. Her family challenged the investigation and fought for access to case records.

item.title: Sierra LaMar Never Made It to the School Bus
item.description: Fifteen-year-old Sierra LaMar disappeared in Morgan Hill, California, in March 2012. DNA evidence became central to the prosecution of Antolin Garcia-Torres, whose 2017 murder conviction was overturned in 2026. Her disappearance left her family searching for answers.

item.title: Heather Elvis Remains Missing Despite Kidnapping Convictions
item.description: Heather Elvis disappeared from South Carolina in December 2013. Sidney and Tammy Moorer were convicted of kidnapping her and each received a 30-year sentence. Murder charges were dropped, and Heather has never been found, leaving her family still searching for answers.

item.title: Greg Mulvihill Survived a Murder Plot by Diana Lovejoy
item.description: During their divorce, Diana Lovejoy recruited her firearms instructor to kill her estranged husband, Greg Mulvihill. He survived the September 2016 shooting in Carlsbad, California. Lovejoy was convicted of conspiracy and attempted murder and sentenced to 26 years to life in 2018.

item.title: Ashley Benefield Claimed Self Defense but Was Convicted
item.description: Former ballerina Ashley Benefield said she shot her estranged husband, Doug, in self-defense in Florida in 2020. Charged with second-degree murder, she was convicted of the lesser offense of manslaughter in July 2024 and sentenced to 20 years in prison that December.

item.title: Nicki Lenway Survived a Murder Plot by Her Ex
item.description: Crime scene investigator Nicki Lenway survived a shooting outside a Minneapolis visitation center in April 2022. The investigation exposed a plot organized by her former partner, Timothy Amacher, and carried out by Colleen Larson. Lenway later testified at Amacher’s trial, which ended in his conviction.
